gdn.change: Single-token NEON row-from, row-in-place and four/eight-row-from helpers choose const-generic eight-block staging for rows up to 128 elements and sixteen blocks for eligible wider rows through 256. Both use the existing arithmetic body and failure publication.
gdn.defaultConsumer: The initial single-row change was extended to normal grouped decode after caller review showed Swift ordinarily selects the eight-row helper.
gdn.sourcePayload: At width 128, single-row staging is 512 instead of 1024 bytes; four-row staging is 2048 instead of 4096; eight-row staging is 4096 instead of 8192. Counts describe declared source array payload, not actual stack frames, generated initializer stores or memory traffic.
gdn.controls: Four direct NEON controls compare independent scalar state/output bits at widths 16/112/128/144/240/256, signed zero/subnormal inputs, dot/update/query failures, grouped atomic publication and unsupported zero/tail/over-capacity refusal. Conservative worker and scratch reserves stay charged.

suffix.change: Keep a rejected candidate's already validated target token in a per-round Option and consume it lazily at the existing correction boundary.
suffix.sourceWorkAvoided: One full greedy traversal of 248320 F32 logits per rejected round for Swift. No evaluation or callback changes logits between rejection and correction; both cancellation boundaries remain.
suffix.controls: Independent fixed token oracles and ordinary-generation comparisons cover initial/partial rejection, accepted chains, bonus, EOS/output bounds, complete decoder traces and logits bits. Separate checks inject cancellation before/after correction, verify no correction evaluation/emission, restore exact state and continue. No sampling policy, transaction or default changes.

nativeQ2.change: Store the immutable HVX prefetch/row-size/VTCM solver tuple with each private resident weight handle at validated preparation; use it for every resident single, secondary-arena, batched and fused FFN descriptor. Transient descriptors still solve active geometry.
nativeQ2.resources: The registry adds no per-handle collection. Existing size_of-based runtime metadata reservation and postallocation checks charge the larger handles under the unchanged cap. Signed kernels, packed layout, placement, terminal failure policy, operation/deadline limits and vendor cleanup remain unchanged.
nativeQ2.controls: Portable independent solver allocation algebra and exact kernel-parameter bytes across 24 geometries including the 6144-column threshold; complete resident/transient frame parity with signed zero/subnormal activations; malformed geometry publishes no reservation. The existing small mock sibling/multitoken batching control also passes with the larger handles.

implemented.hostedGate: The owner-operated fixed inventory now includes all eight new controls and the dependent runtime batching regression, with Windows ARM64 NEON controls separate from portable solver/wire controls. Existing source/compiler/executable binding, strict Release analysis, feature-disabled fallback and production linking remain required. No workflow was run.
